verdict.rationale: Gitleaks-Action and pre-commit hooks let scans run automatically in the background whenever commits or PRs happen, without manual invocation, which satisfies the 'runs autonomously' part of the story. However, this is traditional CI/CD/git-hook automation, not AI-agent-oriented automation (no MCP server, no agent-triggered scheduling, no AI orchestration hooks) that an AI-native user would set up. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific automation triggers, scheduling APIs, or agent-orchestrated workflows beyond standard CI/pre-commit integration.
